title: Works great! Runs a long time
text:
Works great! Runs a long time. This works great with or without oils. On high it runs about 24 hours on medium setting, on low it runs about 36 hours. It's easy to use, right out of the box. Puts moisture in the dry CO air.
It's a quiet machine.

I recommend this humidifier!

product_metadata.title: Holmes Ultrasonic Cool Mist Humidifier, 0.5 Gallon Ultrasonic Humidifier with Aromatherapy Tray and Protection
features: ULTRASONIC HOLMES HUMIDIFIER: This energy efficient Holmes ultrasonic humidifier propels visible cool mist, with a virtually silent, filter-free operation
24-HOUR RUNTIME COOL-MIST HUMIDIFIER: 0.5-gallon-capacity water tank with a 35-hour run time on a full tank and Low setting
PROTECTION: Includes an protective material in the water tank to stop the growth of foreign particles
IDEAL SMALL SPACE HUMIDIFIER: Ideal for small rooms, plus its compact size allows for portability

AROMATHERAPY & VICKS VAPOPADS: Includes an aromatherapy tray to add fragrant moisture to the home, that's also compatible with Vicks VapoPads Refill Scent Pads.* *VICKS and VapoPads are trademarks of The Procter & Gamble Company. description: The Holmes 0.5-Gallon Ultrasonic Humidifier features a 360-degree rotating cool-mist nozzle and one-touch button for easy use. This Holmes humidifier is energy efficient, filter-free, and includes an aromatherapy tray to use with your favorite essential oils. It's also compatible with Vicks VapoPads Refill Scent Pads.* Its virtually silent operation and 0.5-gallon water tank propels visible, cool mist for up to 24 hours on its Low setting. The tank features a protection to stop foreign particles. This portable humidifier is easy to move around your home.*VICKS and VapoPads are trademarks of The Procter & Gamble Company.
